Job Description:

Director, Domain Enterprise Architect, RPA and Intelligent Automation

Reporting to the Assistant Vice President, Enterprise Architecture, Core Platforms, the Director, Domain Enterprise Architect, RPA and Intelligent Automation leads the architecture for Sun Life’s Intelligent Automation platforms.

The Director defines the RPA and Intelligent Automation domain strategy, future-state architectures, standards, reference architectures, and technology roadmaps. The scope includes RPA, Intelligent Document Processing, Microsoft Power Platform, process mining, workflow orchestration, and Agentic AI capabilities applied to business process automation.

Working with business leaders, Technology Executives, other Enterprise Architects, application development teams, AI platform teams, security, privacy, operations, and engineering groups, the Director aligns Intelligent Automation investments and architecture decisions with business priorities, regulatory obligations, operational requirements, and measurable outcomes.

What will you do?

Define and maintain the RPA and Intelligent Automation domain architecture strategy, principles, standards, and technology roadmaps.
Assess the current-state RPA and Intelligent Automation architecture to identify capability gaps, risks, redundant technologies, technical debt, and opportunities for consolidation or modernization.
Define future-state architectures for RPA, intelligent document workflows, low-code automation, process mining, workflow orchestration, AI-assisted operations, and Agentic AI capabilities applied to business processes.
Establish architecture patterns, guardrails, decision frameworks, and reference architectures that enable secure, scalable, resilient, auditable, and production-ready Intelligent Automation capabilities.
Collaborate with business leaders and Technology Executives to communicate architecture direction, options, trade-offs, investment considerations, risks, and expected outcomes for RPA and Intelligent Automation.
Drive platform standardization, reusable automation patterns, and approved citizen and professional development approaches to reduce duplication and improve delivery efficiency.
Collaborate with Enterprise, Domain, Solution, Application, Data, Cloud, Infrastructure, Security, Privacy, and AI Platform Architects to align automation decisions and resolve cross-domain dependencies.
Lead RPA and Intelligent Automation domain architecture governance, including architecture reviews, risk assessments, exception management, and architecture decision records, ensuring alignment with security, privacy, responsible AI, resilience, operational, regulatory, and compliance requirements.

What you’ll need to succeed?

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline. A master’s degree is preferred.
Enterprise architecture credentials such as TOGAF, IASA CITA, or an equivalent architecture certification are preferred.
Relevant certifications in RPA, Microsoft Power Platform, workflow automation, process mining, AI, security, or related technologies are considered assets.
10 or more years of progressive architecture experience, including enterprise, domain, portfolio, application, or platform architecture responsibility.
Significant experience designing, governing, and modernizing enterprise RPA, Intelligent Automation, workflow, or business process technology platforms.
Deep expertise in at least one major Intelligent Automation capability and broad knowledge across RPA, Intelligent Document Processing, Microsoft Power Platform, process mining, workflow orchestration, Generative AI, and Agentic AI integration patterns.
Demonstrated experience defining RPA and Intelligent Automation architecture strategies, future-state architectures, technology roadmaps, standards, reference architectures, and governance practices.
Proven ability to collaborate with Technology Executives and influence senior business and technology leaders through clear analysis, architecture options, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations.
Strong strategic thinking with the ability to translate business priorities, executive direction, regulatory obligations, operational risks, and technology constraints into actionable RPA and Intelligent Automation architecture direction.
Knowledge of AI governance, AI risk management, responsible AI principles, privacy requirements, and enterprise AI adoption patterns as they apply to Intelligent Automation.
Ability to assess automation requirements and determine the appropriate platform, integration pattern, architecture approach, governance controls, and delivery boundaries.
Strong financial and analytical acumen, including investment prioritization, value realization, platform rationalization, technical debt, risk, and technology portfolio trade-offs.

What’s in it for you?

A competitive salary and bonus program, based on market scale
A flexible group insurance program starting on your first day of work to meet your needs and those of your family.
Time off that allows you to focus on the moments that matter most. 20 vacation days per year.
Our Share Ownership Program gives you the opportunity to invest in Sun Life while benefiting from employer matching contributions.
We are proud to be included in Great Place to Work's 2026 list of Canada's Best Workplaces.
Working together, sharing common values, and encouraging growth & achievement.

As this position is posted in several locations, we specify that bilingualism (French, English, both oral and written) is required for Quebec only as the position includes managing both French and English-speaking staff (Quebec and outside Quebec) and providing daily support to the team.

The Base Pay range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. It may vary depending on the work location of the successful candidate or other factors. In addition to Base Pay, eligible Sun Life employees participate in various incentive plans, payment under which is discretionary and subject to individual and company performance. Certain sales focused roles have sales incentive plans based on individual or group sales results.

Diversity and inclusion have always been at the core of our values at Sun Life. A diverse workforce with wide perspectives and creative ideas benefits our Clients, the communities where we operate and all of us as colleagues. We welcome applications from qualified individuals from all backgrounds.

Persons with disabilities who need accommodation in the application process, or those needing job postings in an alternative format, may e-mail a request to thebrightside@sunlife.com.

We are proud to be a hybrid organization that offers our employees the choice and flexibility to work from both the office and virtually based on the needs of the business, our Clients and you.

Job Description:

Director, Domain Enterprise Architect, Technology Modernization and Cloudification

Reporting to the Assistant Vice President, Enterprise Architecture, Core Platforms
, the Director, Domain Enterprise Architect, Technology Modernization and Cloudification leads the architecture for modernizing and migrating Sun Life’s on-premises technology estate to the cloud.

The Director defines the domain strategy, future-state architecture, standards, reference architectures, and transition roadmaps. The scope includes OpenShift, virtualization, servers, operating systems, databases, storage technologies, and related infrastructure services.

Working with Technology Executives, other Enterprise Architects, engineering leaders, cybersecurity, cloud engineering, AI platform teams, and application development, the Director aligns cloud migration with enterprise priorities, regulatory obligations, operational requirements, and cost outcomes. The role also leads AI-enabled automation projects that accelerate modernization.

What will you do?

Lead AI-enabled automation projects that accelerate technology discovery, estate analysis, dependency mapping, migration planning, remediation, testing, and architecture documentation.
Define and maintain the domain architecture strategy, future-state architectures, principles, standards, reference architectures, and decision boundaries.
Develop and maintain an integrated roadmap for migrating on-premises container, virtualization, server, operating system, database, storage, and related infrastructure technologies to cloud services.
Maintain architecture documentation covering the existing technology estate, target cloud architectures, transition plans, dependencies, architecture decisions, lifecycle risks, technical debt, and retirement plans.
Collaborate with Technology Executives to communicate architecture direction, options, trade-offs, dependencies, investment considerations, risks, and modernization outcomes, and align cloud migration roadmaps with enterprise and operational priorities.
Assess the current-state technology estate to identify cloud migration opportunities, unsupported technologies, security vulnerabilities, platform fragmentation, technical debt, lifecycle exposure, resilience gaps, and operational risks.
Define target cloud architectures, workload placement direction, transition states, migration sequencing, dependencies, and retirement plans that support the progressive reduction of the on-premises technology estate.
Establish architecture patterns and decision frameworks for rehosting, re-platforming, refactoring, consolidating, containerizing, replacing, retiring, or temporarily retaining technologies.
Provide subject-matter expertise and architectural leadership across cloud infrastructure and platform services, Red Hat OpenShift, Kubernetes, virtualization, servers, operating systems, enterprise databases, storage technologies, and related infrastructure services.
Identify barriers to cloud migration and define the application, data, security, privacy, network, identity, integration, operational, and platform changes required to address them.
Evaluate relevant cloud capabilities, managed services, and vendor offerings to inform future-state architecture, technology standards, migration approaches, and investment recommendations, and collaborate with Enterprise Architects, Business Group Architects, Solution Architects, and engineering leaders to align migration decisions and cross-domain dependencies.
Lead domain architecture governance and ensure architecture decisions are traceable, implementable, and aligned with security, resilience, operational, financial, regulatory, and compliance requirements.

What you'll need to succeed?

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related discipline. A master’s degree is preferred.
Enterprise architecture credentials such as TOGAF, IASA CITA, or an equivalent architecture certification are preferred.
Advanced cloud architecture certification is strongly preferred.
Relevant infrastructure, container, database, virtualization, storage, networking, automation, or security certifications are considered assets.
10 or more years of progressive architecture experience, including enterprise, domain, cloud, infrastructure, platform, or cross-technology responsibility.
Extensive experience designing enterprise cloud architectures and leading the architectural migration of large-scale on-premises technology estates to cloud infrastructure, managed services, and cloud-native capabilities.
Demonstrated experience defining cloud strategies, future-state architectures, transition roadmaps, workload placement direction, architecture standards, modernization patterns, and technology retirement plans.
Broad architecture experience across cloud services, Red Hat OpenShift, Kubernetes, virtualization, servers, operating systems, enterprise databases, storage, networking, identity, security, resilience, observability, and automation.
Proven ability to collaborate with Technology Executives and influence senior technology leaders through clear analysis, architecture options, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations.
Excellent mastery of cloud architecture, managed platform services, cloud-native patterns, migration architectures, hybrid transition states, and enterprise cloud operating considerations.
Ability to translate enterprise priorities, executive direction, regulatory obligations, operational risks, and technology constraints into actionable modernization and cloudification direction.
Ability to assess complex technology estates and determine the appropriate cloud destination, service model, migration approach, sequencing, transition architecture, and retirement path.
Excellent executive communication, facilitation, negotiation, and influence, with the ability to provide implementable architecture direction without assuming engineering, delivery, or operational ownership.
A clear and actionable Technology Modernization and Cloudification strategy and roadmap covering on-premises containers, virtualization, servers, operating systems, databases, storage technologies, and their target cloud services.
Measurable migration of on-premises technologies and workloads to approved cloud services, supported by defined target architectures, transition states, migration sequencing, and retirement plans.
Measurable acceleration and reduced manual effort in technology discovery, migration planning, remediation, and documentation through AI-enabled automation.

jobs.title: Director of Data
jobs.description:
Purpose in Every Position

Pebl puts a world of talent at your fingertips. With our AI-powered Global Work Platform™, companies can hire, pay, and manage employees in 185+ countries—removing risk, red tape, and guesswork from global growth. Backed by more than a decade of compliance leadership and local expertise, Pebl helps businesses move fast, stay compliant, and scale with confidence. With Pebl, companies everywhere can hire great talent anywhere.

Where Your Work Moves the Needle.

At Pebl, every team member drives our success. Joining us means more than filling a role—you’re accountable for results and impact. Our values guide how we operate, execute, and collaborate across borders. By putting them into action, you’ll help us scale faster, compete harder, and lead the future of global work.

What Makes You a Great Fit

We are seeking a highly technical, deeply analytical, and aggressively innovative Director of Data to lead our data strategy, infrastructure, and AI integration. You will not just be managing a team; you will be the chief storyteller for our data and the evangelist for our "AI Everywhere" initiative.

Based out of our Palo Alto office, you will sit at the intersection of R&D and our core business functions—specifically Marketing, Sales, Operations, Finance, and Legal—ensuring that Pebl’s vast repository of global employment and compliance data is secure, accessible, and actionable.

In-office collaboration is required at our Toronto office Monday through Wednesday.

How You'll Make An Impact

Architect the Future (Technical & Hands-On Data Engineering)
Own the vision and execution of Pebl’s modern data infrastructure.
Serve as the ultimate technical authority on data engineering, ensuring highly scalable, performant, and reliable data pipelines.
Champion strict data security, privacy, and governance protocols to protect our global payroll, HR, and compliance data.
Drive Actionable Business Insights (Analytical Powerhouse)
Transform complex datasets into clear, actionable strategies across all departments.
Partner with Marketing and Sales to optimize our growth funnel, CAC, and conversion rates.
Collaborate with Operations, Finance, and Legal to improve billing accuracy, payroll speed, and compliance tracking.
Champion "AI Everywhere" (AI Native Operations)
Lead the charge to make Pebl a truly AI-native company.
Bring AI capabilities to our R&D offerings, such as enhancing our compliance assistant, Alfie.
Engage directly with Marketing, Sales, Operations, Finance, and Legal to embed AI into their daily workflows, driving massive internal efficiency.
Bridge the Gap (Communication & Storytelling)
Act as the ultimate translator between deep technical R&D work and overarching business objectives.
Master the art of data storytelling to present complex insights to the executive team and the board in a compelling way.
Build and Foster the Team (Leadership)
Lead the Charge: Be a hands-on, execution-oriented leader who ensures delivery of strong business results.
Be the NBA Coach: Recruit top-tier talent and assemble a high-performing team of data engineers, analysts, and AI specialists.
Be the Gardener: Foster a culture of continuous learning and psychological safety to cultivate a data-driven mindset across the entire company.

Let's Connect If You Have

Extensive Technical Background: 15+ years of experience in data engineering, data science, or analytics, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.
Modern Stack Mastery: Deep, hands-on expertise orchestrating our specific modern data infrastructure stack: Snowflake, Fivetran, Atlan, Looker, and Monte Carlo.
AI/ML Track Record: Proven experience deploying LLMs, machine learning models, and AI tools for both production products and internal operational workflows.
Cross-Functional Business Acumen: Demonstrated ability to collaborate with Marketing, Sales, Operations, Finance, and Legal to tie data initiatives directly to top-line growth and bottom-line efficiency.
Exceptional Communication: A track record of weaving data into compelling business narratives for non-technical stakeholders.
Work Style: Ability to work from our Palo Alto office Monday through Wednesday to collaborate directly with the executive and R&D teams.

Our Commitment to You

At Pebl, we’re committed to supporting our team with comprehensive rewards and benefits designed to meet diverse needs across roles and locations. Our core offerings include:

Flexible Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge.
Parental Leave – Support for growing families.
Health and Dental Insurance – Where applicable, to cover you and your loved ones.
Retirement Savings + Employee Incentive Plan – Plan for the future while sharing our success.

Please visit our career page for more information.

We power global teams and believe diverse perspectives drive innovation and impact. Employment decisions at Pebl are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive culture where every teammate can thrive and do the best work of their career—anywhere in the world.

jobs.title: Directeur régional des technologies de l’information - Région de Montréal/Information Technology Regional Director - Montreal
jobs.description:
MDA Space (TSX : MDA) est un partenaire de mission de confiance de l’industrie spatiale mondiale qui crée l’espace entre ce qui est prouvé et ce qui est possible. À titre de pionnier de la robotique, des systèmes satellitaires et du renseignement géospatial, avec une histoire de 55 ans de premières mondiales et de plus de 450 missions, MDA Space est un chef de file mondial dans les domaines des satellites de communication, de l’observation de la Terre et de l’espace, ainsi que de l’infrastructure et l’exploration spatiale. L’équipe de MDA Space, qui compte plus de 4 000 experts du secteur spatial au Canada, aux États-Unis et au Royaume-Uni, possède les connaissances et le savoir-faire nécessaires pour transformer la vision audacieuse du client en une mission réalisable, grâce à une combinaison unique d’expérience, d’excellence technique et d’émerveillement qui fait partie de notre ADN depuis le premier jour. Pour ceux qui rêvent grand et repoussent les limites sur terre et dans les étoiles afin de changer le monde pour le meilleur, nous vous y emmènerons.

Le Rôle

MDA Space connaît une croissance fulgurante, et nous sommes à la recherche d’un dirigeant technologique visionnaire pour piloter l’expérience informatique de plus de 2 000 collaborateurs
répartis entre Montréal, Kirkland, Sainte-Anne-de-Bellevue et d’autres emplacements stratégiques. Vous serez responsable de l’expérience utilisateur de bout en bout, mènerez des projets d’amélioration des services, gérerez les contrats avec les fournisseurs et veillerez au respect des normes ITIL/ITSM, de cybersécurité et de plan de continuité des activités (PCA). Si vous vous épanouissez dans des environnements dynamiques et à fort impact, et que vous aimez transformer des environnements techniques complexes en services fluides et centrés sur l’utilisateur, ce poste vous permettra de propulser votre carrière vers de nouveaux horizons.

Le directeur régional des technologies de l’information (TI), région de Montréal, supervisera la prestation des services informatiques locaux pour l’emplacement de Montréal et les emplacements environnants, en veillant à offrir une expérience employé de qualité, à garantir la fiabilité des opérations et à respecter les normes de MDA Space. À ce titre, il travaillera en collaboration avec les dirigeants locaux, les équipes de TI régionales, les fournisseurs et les intervenants de l’entreprise afin d’améliorer la qualité des services, de soutenir la croissance, de gérer les risques et de s’assurer que les services de TI répondent aux besoins actuels et futurs de l’entreprise.

Principales Responsabilités

Favoriser une excellente expérience des collaborateurs de TI sur les sites relevant de sa responsabilité / entrant dans son champ d’action
Favoriser l’implication des services de TI au sein du site – en veillant à ce que les collaborateurs des TI travaillent comme une seule et même équipe
Diriger les services de TI locaux afin d’offrir une expérience employé homogène et de grande qualité à Montréal et aux emplacements environnants.
Collaborer avec les dirigeants du site et les équipes des TI régionales afin de soutenir la croissance, de résoudre les problèmes et d’améliorer le rendement des services.
Communiquer de manière claire et concrète sur les services des TI, les normes, le rendement et la sensibilisation à la cybersécurité au sein du site.
Surveiller les performances des services locaux, les risques et les plans d’amélioration à l’aide de rapports et de tableaux de bord standardisés.
Veiller à ce que l’infrastructure, les outils et les services locaux respectent les normes de MDA Space et garantissent la continuité des activités.
Servir de point de contact local pour les incidents informatiques, les projets et les problèmes liés aux services, en assurant la coordination avec les équipes concernées pour trouver des solutions.
Soutenir les équipes de production et d’exploitation en garantissant que les services de TI sont fiables, cohérents et alignés sur les priorités de l’entreprise.
Superviser les ressources de TI locales, les services des fournisseurs, les contrats et la mise en œuvre des projets liés aux modifications ou aux extensions des sites.
Veiller au respect des exigences en matière de TI, de sécurité, de gestion des actifs, de la norme SOX et d’assurance qualité.

Direction Et Relations

Établir d’excellentes relations avec les dirigeants locaux, les partenaires commerciaux, les équipes de TI et les fournisseurs afin de garantir que les services répondent aux besoins de l’entreprise.
Diriger, encadrer et soutenir l’équipe des TI locale tout en encourageant la collaboration, la responsabilisation et l’amélioration continue.
Représenter le service des TI au niveau local et aider les employés à comprendre l’assistance, les services et les interlocuteurs à leur disposition.

A clear and actionable Technology Modernization and Cloudification strategy and roadmap covering on-premises containers, virtualization, servers, operating systems, databases, storage technologies, and their target cloud services.

Work Model: Primarily Remote

Location: GTHA (must be able to travel onsite in the GTHA approximately once a month)

Overview

Our client is seeking a hands-on Interim CFO / Director of Finance to lead the finance function during a period of operational and organizational change. The successful candidate will evaluate the current finance environment, strengthen reporting and controls, support the stabilization of an ERP implementation, and provide leadership to the finance team while helping build a scalable foundation for future growth

Key Responsibilities

Take ownership of the finance and accounting function across multiple North American entities.
Operate effectively in an environment where priorities evolve and not all issues are fully defined at the outset.
Evaluate existing accounting processes, identify gaps, and implement sustainable improvements.
Ensure accurate and timely financial reporting for executive leadership, the Board, ownership stakeholders, and other key business partners.
Lead the stabilization and optimization of an ERP implementation, ensuring accurate data migration, process alignment, system adoption, and reporting integrity.
Strengthen controls, reconciliations, cash management, payroll, and commission-related processes.
Improve month-end and year-end close procedures and establish greater accountability within the finance team.
Partner closely with executive leadership to support strategic decision-making and business growth.
Provide hands-on support with complex accounting, operational, and reporting matters.
Support a highly regulated business operating across multiple jurisdictions, currencies, and legal entities.
Manage reporting requirements and communications with senior stakeholders, including Board-level audiences.
Navigate and support high-volume commission and compensation environments.

Qualifications

CPA designation required.
Previous success stabilizing, rebuilding, or upgrading finance functions.
Strong technical accounting and financial reporting experience within IFRS and/or US GAAP environments.
Experience leading ERP implementations or system optimization projects.
Proven ability to quickly identify priorities and implement practical solutions.
Experience supporting multi-entity, multi-currency, and cross-border operations.
Experience within financial services, banking, insurance, distribution, or other complex commission-based business models is considered an asset.
Background working in high-growth, entrepreneurial, founder-led, or rapidly evolving organizations.
Comfortable balancing strategic leadership with day-to-day execution.
Strong communication skills with the ability to explain financial matters to non-finance audiences.
Calm, pragmatic, and solutions-oriented leadership style.
Demonstrated ability to drive accountability, prioritize effectively, and execute with urgency.
